name: heikin_ashi_trend_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP algorithms executing large directional orders create 30-90 second micro-trends where each 5-second bar is consistently one-directional — price opens, moves in the trend direction, and closes near the extreme with minimal opposition. Heikin Ashi candles detect this by averaging OHLC: when 3+ consecutive green HA bars have no lower wick (HA_low ≈ HA_open), it confirms that NIFTY sellers are absent within every 5-second interval — not just that closing price drifted higher, but that the full bar interior belongs to buyers. This HA streak pattern, confirmed by price above session VWAP and 3-min EMA above 9-min EMA, identifies the 30-90 second continuation window before the institutional batch order completes or exhausts its available supply.

indicators.name: ha_close
indicators.purpose: Heikin Ashi synthetic close — 4-price average centers the bar, reducing the weight of single-tick extremes. No lookback required; computed bar by bar.

indicators.name: ha_open
indicators.purpose: Heikin Ashi synthetic open — recursive average smooths the open, filtering single-bar gap noise common in index futures. Initialised at bar 0 as (open + close) / 2.

indicators.name: ha_high
indicators.purpose: HA high — ensures the bar high encompasses both the synthetic body and the actual bar high. Used to measure upper wick for red bars.

indicators.name: ha_low
indicators.purpose: HA low — ensures the bar low encompasses both the synthetic body and the actual bar low. Used to measure lower wick for green bars.

indicators.name: consec_green
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where ha_close > ha_open (reset at day boundary)
indicators.purpose: Counts consecutive green HA bars. Lookback of 6 bars (30s) is sufficient; we only need ≥3 to signal a micro-trend. Day-boundary reset prevents carry-over from prior sessions.

indicators.name: consec_red
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where ha_close < ha_open (reset at day boundary)
indicators.purpose: Same as consec_green for bearish streaks. Together they gate entries to clean trend runs, filtering choppy HA color flips that occur 1-2x per minute in ranging markets.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open; typical = (H+L+C)/3
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP — cumulative measure, no scaling needed. VWAP is the benchmark for every VWAP-weighted algorithm on NIFTY; price above VWAP means buyers are being filled better than VWAP, reinforcing continuation.

indicators.name: ema_fast
indicators.purpose: EMA(36) = 3-minute fast EMA on actual close. Compressed from original EMA(9) at 1-min (9 min) to 3 min because we hold 30-90s, not 5-20 min. Confirms the immediate price trajectory — not just the HA signal — is directional.

indicators.name: ema_slow
indicators.purpose: EMA(108) = 9-minute slow EMA. Compressed from original EMA(21) at 1-min (21 min). Provides broader trend context. When fast > slow, the 3-min micro-trend is aligned with the 9-min institutional flow direction — reducing counter-trend entries.

conditions: strong_green: ha_close > ha_open AND ha_lower_wick < 20% of ha_body (no sellers within the bar)
consec_green >= 3 (at least 15 seconds of clean green HA bars — not a single-bar spike)
close > vwap (actual price above session VWAP — bullish institutional benchmark)
ema_fast > ema_slow (3-min trend aligned with 9-min trend)
vix between 12 and 25 (trend regime, not dead or chaotic)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true on same 5-second bar

conditions: strong_red: ha_close < ha_open AND ha_upper_wick < 20% of ha_body (no buyers within the bar)
consec_red >= 3 (at least 15 seconds of clean red HA bars)
close < vwap (actual price below session VWAP — bearish institutional benchmark)
ema_fast < ema_slow (3-min trend aligned with 9-min trend)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true on same 5-second bar

entry.entry_price: limit order at candle close (actual close, not HA close — HA is synthetic and non-executable)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. A genuine institutional micro-trend on NIFTY should not retrace 8 spot points within 30 seconds — if it does, the batch order has absorbed and the thesis is wrong. From the reference table, 30s moves are 2-5 pts; a 4pt stop provides a 15-second buffer beyond the typical noise range.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. Institutional TWAP batches that produce 3+ clean HA bars typically continue for 20-30 spot points before exhausting (1-2 min hold). 14 spot points captures ~50-60% of the expected first leg, providing 1:1.75 R:R at 4pt stop.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 12 and 25 — below 12 = dead market with no HA trends, above 25 = too chaotic and HA lags amplify whipsaws
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min (HA needs initialization and opening noise subsides), flatten 10 min before close
filters.volume_filter: none — HA smoothing implicitly filters low-volume noise bars via body size; ha_body > 0.1 NIFTY point enforced in code
filters.trend_filter: EMA(36) > EMA(108) for bullish, < for bearish
filters.spread_filter: not required — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-medium — HA is well-known but the specific combination of no-wick strength + consecutive count + VWAP + dual EMA alignment creates a selective signal that fires 4-8 times/day, not on every HA color change. Most traders using HA enter on simple color change, not the stricter no-wick + streak criteria.

adaptation_notes: Original traded NIFTY50 constituent stocks at 1-min bars with 5-20 min hold. Converted to NIFTY index at 5s with 30-90s hold. Key changes: (1) HA lookback is unchanged in concept (recursive formula) but now operates on 5s bars giving finer granularity — 3 consecutive bars = 15s vs 3 min originally; (2) EMA periods compressed from 9/21 min to 3/9 min proportionally to match shorter hold; (3) VWAP unchanged as cumulative measure; (4) eliminated trailing HA stop (too complex for 5s holds, time_stop_bars handles it); (5) stops/targets calibrated to NIFTY option premium points not bps of equity price. The core insight — HA no-wick bars signal clean institutional directional flow — is stronger on the index than on individual stocks because index flow is dominated by large institutional orders, not retail.
weaknesses: HA recursive formula means early-session bars (first 10-20 bars) have synthetic HA_open far from true price equilibrium — hence the 09:25 session start.
Requires 3+ consecutive bars meaning entry fires on bar 3+ of a trend, not bar 1 — always entering slightly late into a move.
In strongly gapping days, VWAP filter can suppress most signals early session when price remains far from prior-session VWAP.
The wick tolerance (20% of body) is sensitive to tiny-body bars at 5s resolution — very small HA bodies can produce strong signals on what are essentially flat bars.
